networks.name: Shopee Affiliate
networks.evidence: Shopee's Malaysia Help Center describes its in-house affiliate program: affiliates use social platforms to recommend Shopee items through unique URLs and earn commission on successful purchases.

networks.name: TikTok Shop Affiliate
networks.evidence: TikTok Shop Malaysia provides an Affiliate Creator program for promoting products through creator content; current eligibility and feature access are controlled by TikTok.

networks.name: Lazada Affiliate
networks.evidence: Lazada Malaysia describes its affiliate program for promoting products through social channels, websites and apps, with commission depending on product/category and program terms.

verification.unknown_policy: Never infer or invent missing commercial facts. Keep them unknown until authoritative evidence is captured.
